About Hochelaga-Maisonneuve

Hochelaga-Maisonneuve has a character that caters to a fairly diverse group of people. The noise levels in Hochelaga-Maisonneuve are low, as noise from streets and other parts of the city is rarely an issue, although that is not the case around one of the railway lines. There is a good amount of greenery in this area as many tree-lined streets are around. Parks, like Parc Champêtre, are especially well-distributed and there are around 20 of them close by for residents to check out, which makes them very easy to access. Lastly, this part of Montréal has numerous streets for those looking for a dynamic vibe. Despite the fact that there are few nearby entertainment venues, there are crowds of people around most of the time, and places to go out at night are well-spread throughout the area. Rue Ontario in particular offers a vast selection of bars.
